name: isocan
description: The isocan canvas bound to your workspace, in a pane beside the chat and without a second chat column. New conversations join the canvas under their own names, and the pane enrols model-pinned standing agents.
suggestedPrompts: Open the isocan canvas for this workspace and tell me what is on it
Address the open comments on the canvas
Run a visual arena on a canvas item with two model-pinned agents
